---
title: Output formatting validation
---

{{< include /scripts/matrix-rendering.qmd >}}

```{r}
library(lavaan)
f1 <- cfa("visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3", data=HolzingerSwineford1939)
f2 <- cfa("visual =~ x1 + a*x2 + a*x3", data=HolzingerSwineford1939)
matrix(c(1, 1e-100, -1e-100, 0), 2)
fitMeasures(f2)[c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "cfi")]
anova(f1, f2)
inspect(f2)
coef(f2)
summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))
```
